title: Comment Inbox Reply Draft
description: Schema for comment and inbox reply drafts produced by the Comment Inbox Agent. No auto-reply without Owner Approved status.

brand_id.description: Brand identifier. Default: VQ for Vị Cuốn.

channel.description: Channel where the customer message originated.

customer_message.description: Verbatim customer message or comment. Do not modify or summarize.

detected_intent.description: Agent-detected intent of the customer message.

sentiment.description: Agent-assessed sentiment of the customer message.

draft_reply.description: Draft reply text. Set to null if escalation_required is true — never draft for escalation cases.

escalation_required.description: True if this case must be handled by Owner directly. True for: Complaint, Sensitive/Legal, Angry sentiment.

escalation_reason.description: Required if escalation_required is true. Explain why escalation is needed.

human_review_required.description: Always true. No reply is ever sent without human review.

approval_status.description: Auto-reply cannot happen without Approved status.

created_by_agent.description: Agent that created this reply draft.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this reply draft was created.

notes.description: Optional notes for the Owner or Reviewer.
